description: This class defines the ReadableOrder entity, extending OrderEntity, representing an order with associated customer, products, currency, billing/delivery addresses, and totals.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer associated with this order.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer associated with this order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount for this order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the order.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the tax amount for this order.

methods.name: setTax
methods.description: Sets the tax amount for this order.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns the shipping cost for this order.

methods.name: setShipping
methods.description: Sets the shipping cost for this order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of products in the order.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of products in the order.

methods.name: getCurrencyModel
methods.description: Returns the currency model used for the order.

methods.name: setCurrencyModel
methods.description: Sets the currency model for the order.
